title: The additive logistic model

blocks.what_we_do: Fit a one-variant logistic regression in R and connect dosage to the odds ratio.
blocks.why: For binary outcome Y, logistic regression models log(p/(1-p)) = intercept + beta * dosage, where p is the probability of being a case. An additive model assumes the same change in log odds for each additional counted allele. exp(beta) is the per-allele OR; it differs from the carrier contrast at 6.1. The standard error measures uncertainty in the estimated log OR. This unadjusted one-site example is not the final association result.
blocks.you_need: The one-variant export from 6.1 and the final PSAM.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-2}
x <- read.table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "6.1", "example"), ".raw"), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
psam <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.7"), ".psam"))
example <- data.frame(case = as.numeric(psam$Disease[match(x$IID, psam$IID)] == "2"), dosage = as.numeric(x[[7]]))
fit <- glm(case ~ dosage, data = example, family = binomial())
summary(fit)
exp(coef(fit)["dosage"])
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: no PLINK operation is needed for this R-only or laboratory step. The R chunk is the complete command; PLINK cannot perform a laboratory measurement.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
An intercept and dosage coefficient, with a standard error and p-value. The unadjusted per-allele OR and carrier OR need not be equal.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the instructor reference.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
What does beta = 0 imply for the per-allele odds ratio?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

exp(0) = 1: no estimated per-allele change in odds.

</details>
blocks.files_created: The example model exists in R memory only; the genotype export remains on disk.
